name: skrupa
description: Sebastian Krupa's skills. Coach: personal coach for Claude Desktop Projects (one project per person) with summary, motivation, revision, fitness, daily and weekly planner. Decision: ask a local decision model (llama.cpp) typed questions, size estimates, and which Claude model and effort fit a task; run a task or a whole plan with subagents. The decision model is chosen per run; the default is basal-omni-1.0-ultra Q4_K_S.
